subject.title: feat(onboarding): prefer strongest local model in guided detection

question: Should this frequently retuned setup-assistant model ranking be a supported public Plugin SDK API, and if so should its name and contract be narrowed to guided onboarding?
rationale: Two bundled providers share the invariant, which supports a shared helper, but public SDK callers could otherwise treat the heuristic as a general-purpose local-model quality ranking.

options.title: Narrow the public contract
options.body: Keep the shared SDK helper but rename and document it specifically for guided setup-assistant selection, including the LM Studio default exception.

options.title: Accept the current API
options.body: Treat the broadly named selector and its retunable family order as an intentionally supported third-party Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Keep policy private
options.body: Move the ranking behind a non-public onboarding owner seam and avoid adding a new Plugin SDK export.

recommendation.title: Narrow the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the shared SDK helper but rename and document it specifically for guided setup-assistant selection, including the LM Studio default exception.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository-wide CODEOWNERS entry and prior provider-SDK work make steipete the strongest available owner for this API-boundary decision.
